title: Implication through a quantified prefix
statement: Let $K$ be a proposition, let $P$ be a predicate on Boolean assignments $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $qs$ be a finite list of existential and universal quantifiers, and let $\sigma$ be a Boolean assignment with starting index $i$. The quantified formula with matrix $K\to P(\tau)$ is true under $qs,\sigma,i$ if and only if $K$ implies that the quantified formula with matrix $P(\tau)$ is true under the same prefix, assignment, and index.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of existential and universal quantifiers
